items.name: Prism Lantern
items.prism_description: A warm brass-and-glass lantern that illuminates safe paths through Caetherra.
items.dq_description: Its flame casts your shadow twice as long. Something watches from the dark behind you.

items.name: Caetherra Hand Mirror
items.prism_description: A silvered pocket glass that shows you at your warmest and clearest.
items.dq_description: Your reflection blinks a half-second late.

items.name: Silver Thread
items.prism_description: A luminous filament that tugs gently toward people who remember you.
items.dq_description: A tether you did not tie yourself—leading straight toward Vault Seven.

items.name: Warm Iron Key
items.prism_description: A key forged for a door meant to welcome you.
items.dq_description: Still warm from the palm of someone who never came back.

items.name: Vial of Memory Ash
items.prism_description: Soft grey dust from Ashveil's furnaces—remnants of quiet endings.
items.dq_description: Distilled erased memories. Inhaling a pinch exposes fragments of what was burned.

items.name: Crystallized Echo Shard
items.prism_description: A humming glass sliver storing a single unspoken moment.
items.dq_description: Crack it open to feed your resonance—at the cost of waking whatever remembers it.

items.name: Stilling Bell Charm
items.prism_description: A tiny white-bronze bell that steadies your pulse during Veil storms.
items.dq_description: Goes dead silent when the Dark Quasar awakens.

items.name: Obsidian Quasar Lens
items.prism_description: A dark glass monocle that reveals hairline fractures in the Prism.
items.dq_description: Lets you gaze directly into gravitational truth without flinching.
